primary_meaning: Spiritual reconciliation and harmonious relationship with God (and resulting inner wholeness/tranquility) accomplished through Jesus Christ

alternatives.meaning: Eschatological/messianic age of universal harmony free from war and injustice under God's reign
Practical peacemaking, nonviolence, and social reconciliation among people
Hebrew shalom as holistic material/spiritual prosperity, health, and communal well-being
Mere absence of external conflict or emotional calm without theological reference to Christ
basis: secular or purely psychological readings of biblical peace language

notes: Christian interpretation overwhelmingly centers peace on Christ's reconciling work (peace with God) and the resulting gift of the Spirit (peace of God), while still acknowledging OT shalom breadth and NT ethical peacemaking; purely secular or purely political readings remain secondary in classical biblical theology.
